channel.title: RingZine
channel.description: RingZine covers WWE and AEW with answer first results and news. Every story is labelled Confirmed or Rumor and links its sources.

item.title: AEW runs a three-hour Dynamite and Collision tonight as the last stop before Full Gear
item.description: AEW's official preview says the combined show airs live at 8 p.m. ET from the Maverik Center in West Valley City, with a mixed-tag Full Gear preview and a World Title face-off between Ospreay and Fletcher.

item.title: Tony Khan books FTR vs Motor City Machine Guns in Best of 5 Match 5 on Dynamite
item.description: The AEW president said the series is tied 2-2 after last weekend, and that the decider airs on the Wednesday three-hour Dynamite and Collision show.

item.title: Kelani will defend the NXT Women's Title against Kendal Grey next week, WWE says
item.description: WWE announced after Tuesday's NXT that Kelani will put the NXT Women's Championship on the line against Kendal Grey on the following week's show.

item.title: How WWE’s Elimination Chamber Match Works
item.description: How the WWE Elimination Chamber match works: how entrants are released from the pods, what counts as an elimination, and how a winner is decided.

item.title: How a WWE Battle Royal Works: Entries, Eliminations and the Winner
item.description: How a WWE battle royal works: how participants enter, what counts as an elimination, when the winner is decided, and how variants differ from the standard rules.

item.title: Roman Reigns and The Bloodline challenge The 946 to WarGames at Survivor Series
item.description: Raw ended with Jacob Fatu's return, a brawl with The 946 and Roman Reigns laying down a WarGames challenge for Survivor Series.

item.title: Rey Fenix wins triple threat to become number one contender for Ethan Page's Intercontinental title
item.description: Rey Fenix beat Chad Gable and Big Cass on Raw to earn a shot at Ethan Page, before The 946 attacked all three men.

item.title: John Cena sends Zilla Fatu a gift package, and two mystery challenge coins, before the John Cena Classic
item.description: Zilla Fatu showed off a package from John Cena with a Rise Above Hate watch and two gold challenge coins whose purpose in the December 14 John Cena Classic he kept secret.

item.title: Tommaso Ciampa nicknames the AEW National Championship "Ruby" after Collision title win
item.description: In a backstage video after beating Andrade El Idolo on the November 7 Collision filmed on the Chris Jericho Cruise, Ciampa calls the National Championship Ruby and says he wants more AEW gold.

item.title: AEW sets Thanksgiving-night Collision for November 26 after Thanksgiving Eve Dynamite in Omaha
item.description: AEW will tape a special Thanksgiving edition of Collision on November 25 in Omaha and air it on Thursday, November 26, at 8 p.m. ET on TNT and HBO Max.

item.title: WWE Raw November 9 preview: Greenville show advertises Reigns, Oba Femi and Liv Morgan
item.description: WWE's event page lists Monday Night Raw on 9 November at Bon Secours Wellness Arena in Greenville, South Carolina, advertising Roman Reigns, Oba Femi, Liv Morgan, Dominik Mysterio and Sol Ruca. No matches are announced yet.

item.title: Tony Khan books Ciampa vs Speedball Bailey for the AEW National title on 11 November
item.description: Tony Khan announced Tommaso Ciampa will defend the AEW National Championship against Speedball Bailey on the special three-hour Dynamite/Collision on Wednesday 11 November, days after Ciampa won the title from Andrade El Idolo.

item.title: Tommaso Ciampa Wins AEW National Championship From Andrade on Jericho Cruise
item.description: Tommaso Ciampa defeated Andrade El Idolo on the November 7 episode of AEW Collision to become the new AEW National Champion.

item.title: Tiffany Stratton cashes in on Chelsea Green at Crown Jewel as Roman Reigns beats Sami Zayn
item.description: Tiffany Stratton turned on Chelsea Green and cashed in Money in the Bank to win the WWE Women's Championship at Crown Jewel, while Roman Reigns speared Sami Zayn to win the men's Crown Jewel Championship.

item.title: Rey Mysterio to lead Team Mexico at Survivor Series 2026
item.description: Rey Mysterio said he will captain Team Mexico against Team USA in a classic five-on-five Survivor Series match at the 28 November WarGames Premium Live Event in Houston.

item.title: Kevin Owens beats CM Punk in No Holds Barred on SmackDown
item.description: WWE said Kevin Owens defeated CM Punk in a No Holds Barred match on SmackDown. Triple H amplified the official result posts.

item.title: Cody Rhodes beats Randy Orton in Last Man Standing at Crown Jewel
item.description: WWE said Cody Rhodes defeated Randy Orton in a Last Man Standing match at Crown Jewel in Riyadh, including a punt kick finish highlighted on the company's X account.

item.title: AEW Full Gear upgrades trios title match to Texas Death rules
item.description: AEW confirmed on Dynamite that Hangman Page, Bandido and Brody King will defend the World Trios titles against Swerve Strickland, Austin Creed and Kofi under Texas Death rules at Full Gear, with Ospreay vs Fletcher also set.

item.title: AEW Dynamite Blood & Guts tops NXT in Wednesday ratings
item.description: Tony Khan thanked viewers after AEW Dynamite Blood & Guts, saying the show had excellent viewership including AEW's most 18-49 viewers on TBS in years, as F4W/WON reported Dynamite beating WWE NXT head-to-head.

item.title: WWE Road to Survivor Series event delivers Street Fight finish in Portland
item.description: WWE’s Portland, Maine house show on 5 November featured title defences, a six woman tag match and a restarted main event between CM Punk and Kevin Owens.

item.title: WWE announces 11 early 2027 event dates across North America
item.description: WWE announced 11 new North American event dates to open 2027, including nine Raw and SmackDown editions, with tickets on sale 11 November at 10am local time.

item.title: AEW Full Gear: Mercedes Moné defends against Marina Shafir
item.description: AEW booked Mercedes Moné versus Marina Shafir for the AEW Women's World Championship at Full Gear on 14 November, after a confrontation at Blood and Guts.

item.title: Paige Returns to WWE NXT, Loses NXT Women's Title Challenge to Kelani Jordan
item.description: Paige made a surprise NXT return on 4 November 2026 as Kelani Jordan's mystery challenger for the NXT Women's Championship; Jordan retained when she reversed Paige into a roll up / small package after Paige's finishing sequence.

item.title: How a WarGames match works
item.description: WarGames puts two teams inside one cage built over two rings. Wrestlers enter on a timer, one side gets a numbers advantage, and the real match starts only when everyone is in. WWE's version has no roof and allows pinfalls.

item.title: CM Punk Challenges Grayson Waller for NXT Championship Tonight as WWE Loads Up Wednesday Show
item.description: CM Punk returns to an NXT ring tonight for the first time in more than 16 years, challenging Grayson Waller for the NXT Championship on a special Wednesday...

item.title: WWE Raw results, November 2, 2026: Ethan Page wins the Intercontinental title, Cena unveils his Classic
item.description: Ethan Page beat Chad Gable for the Intercontinental Championship in Brooklyn, John Cena set the John Cena Classic for December 14 and named Cody Rhodes the first entrant, and Cruz Montana sided with The 946 against The Bloodline.

item.title: John Cena Classic Set for December 14 as WWE Plans Disney World Event
item.description: WWE has announced a December 14 John Cena Classic at Disney World, part of a two-day event partnership with Disney.

item.title: Ethan Page Wins Intercontinental Title From Chad Gable on November 2 Raw
item.description: Ethan Page captured the Intercontinental Championship from Chad Gable during Monday Night Raw after a hard-fought title match in Brooklyn.

item.title: Cruz Montana Joins The 946 in Raw Confrontation With The Bloodline
item.description: Cruz Montana appeared during a Raw faction brawl and aligned with The 946 against Roman Reigns and The Bloodline.

item.title: WWE Raw preview, November 2, 2026: card and how to watch on Netflix
item.description: WWE goes to Brooklyn for the final Raw before Crown Jewel, with Chad Gable defending the Intercontinental Championship against Ethan Page and John Cena back on the show for a special announcement.

item.title: AEW Collision results, October 31, 2026: Triangle of Madness retain, Dragunov wins
item.description: The Triangle of Madness kept the Artist of Stardom titles against Trinity's team, Ilja Dragunov beat The Beast Mortos, and Tommaso Ciampa earned an AEW National Title shot for next week.

item.title: WWE SmackDown results, October 30, 2026: Zayn keeps the WWE title in a No DQ match
item.description: Sami Zayn beat Trick Williams in a restarted No Disqualification match, Chelsea Green retained against Nikki Bella, and Finn Bálor returned as The Demon to put Gunther through the announce table.

item.title: WWE Crown Jewel 2026 moves indoors to The Venue in Riyadh, reports say
item.description: PWInsider and F4W report that the November 7 Crown Jewel show has moved from the outdoor Riyadh Season Stadium to The Venue, also called ANB Arena, with tickets back on sale.

item.title: CM Punk vs. Kevin Owens is now No Holds Barred for the November 6 SmackDown
item.description: WWE added a No Holds Barred stipulation to CM Punk vs. Kevin Owens on the October 30 SmackDown. The match airs Friday, November 6, the night before Crown Jewel.

item.title: AEW Fright Night Collision preview, October 31, 2026: The Cut vs. The Conglomeration
item.description: Halloween Collision from St. Louis features The Cut against The Conglomeration, an Artist of STARDOM title defense by Triangle of Madness and Ilja Dragunov against The Beast Mortos.

item.title: AEW Fright Night Dynamite draws 620,000 viewers against the World Series, report says
item.description: Wrestlenomics figures reported by Fightful put the October 28 Dynamite at 620,000 TBS viewers and a 0.14 rating among adults 18 to 49, both slightly down from the week before.

item.title: How an AEW Blood and Guts match works
item.description: AEW's Blood and Guts puts two rings under one roofed cage. Wrestlers enter on a clock, there are no pinfalls, and a team wins only when an opponent submits or surrenders.

item.title: WWE Youngstown live event results, October 29, 2026: Gable beats Punk, Zayn retains
item.description: At WWE's Road to Survivor Series tour stop in Youngstown, Ohio, Chad Gable pinned CM Punk and Sami Zayn kept the Undisputed WWE Championship in a triple threat, according to Fightful and PWMania.

item.title: WWE stars join WhatsApp's The Chat: Bella Twins and LA Knight on November 1
item.description: WWE and WhatsApp are running The Chat, a live football group chat on WhatsApp Channels. Nikki and Brie Bella and LA Knight are set for the Eagles vs. Commanders game on November 1.

item.title: WWE SmackDown preview, October 30, 2026: Zayn vs. Williams and Green vs. Bella
item.description: Sami Zayn defends the Undisputed WWE Championship against Trick Williams and Chelsea Green defends the WWE Women's Championship against Nikki Bella on a Halloween themed SmackDown in Charleston, West Virginia.

item.title: Shawn Michaels expected to take Bruce Prichard's WWE creative role, report says
item.description: PWInsider reports WWE plans to move Shawn Michaels into Bruce Prichard's creative writing and talent role after Prichard steps back following WrestleMania 43. WWE has not announced any change.

item.title: AEW Full Gear 2026 adds Anarchy in the Arena: Death Riders vs. The Cut
item.description: Jon Moxley challenged The Cut to Anarchy in the Arena at Full Gear on Fright Night Dynamite. Here is the Full Gear card so far for November 14 in Phoenix.

item.title: How a WWE Last Man Standing match ends
item.description: WWE's Last Man Standing match has no pinfall, no submission, and no disqualification. It ends when a wrestler cannot get up before a count of 10, and a draw leaves a title with the champion.

item.title: AEW books Ospreay vs. Fletcher for Full Gear and a Collision card
item.description: Tony Khan made Will Ospreay versus Kyle Fletcher official for the AEW World Championship at Full Gear. Saturday's Collision has a posted card, and a women's Blood and Guts match is set.

item.title: AEW Fright Night Dynamite results, October 28, 2026: Aminata wins the TBS title
item.description: Queen Aminata beat Persephone for the TBS Championship, Darby Allin kept the TNT Championship against Josh Alexander, and the Motor City Machine Guns took Match 3 from FTR.

item.title: WWE Raw holds at 2.5 million Netflix views for October 19 episode
item.description: Netflix's weekly Top 10 lists the October 19 Raw at 2.5 million views and 4.3 million hours viewed, ninth on its global shows chart.

item.title: WWE NXT results, October 27, 2026: Dusty Cup finals set, Drake retains
item.description: Noam Dar and Romeo Moreno upset The Vanity Project and will meet Hank and Tank in the Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic final, while Jackson Drake kept the North American title.

item.title: WWE Crown Jewel 2026 match card: four matches set for November 7 in Riyadh
item.description: Roman Reigns vs. Sami Zayn and Liv Morgan vs. Chelsea Green headline Crown Jewel on November 7, but both SmackDown champions must first survive title defenses on October 30.

item.title: NXT Halloween Havoc 2026 card and how to watch on October 31
item.description: Grayson Waller defends the NXT Championship against Tony D'Angelo and Kelani Jordan faces Wren Sinclair at Halloween Havoc, live on The CW on Saturday, October 31.

item.title: AEW Fright Night Dynamite preview: Allin vs. Alexander and two more title stakes
item.description: Darby Allin defends the TNT title against Josh Alexander, Persephone faces Queen Aminata for the TBS title, and FTR and the Motor City Machine Guns wrestle Match 3 tonight in St. Louis.

item.title: WWE Raw results, October 26, 2026: Sami Zayn and Liv Morgan keep their titles
item.description: Sami Zayn beat Je'Von Evans to keep the Undisputed WWE Championship, and Liv Morgan kept the Women's World Championship when Becky Lynch won by disqualification.

item.title: Penta and Je'Von Evans get a World Tag Team title match at Crown Jewel
item.description: WWE made Penta and Je'Von Evans vs. Bron Breakker and Austin Theory for the World Tag Team Championship at Crown Jewel on November 7.

item.title: AEW Collision results, October 24, 2026: FTR tie the series, women's Blood and Guts made
item.description: FTR beat the Motor City Machine Guns to tie their Best of 5 series, Jay White beat Kyle O'Reilly, and AEW confirmed a women's Blood and Guts match for November 4.

item.title: AEW Dynamite results, October 21, 2026: Dragunov wins debut, men's Blood and Guts set
item.description: Ilja Dragunov beat Mike Bailey in his AEW debut, Queen Aminata earned a TBS title shot, and the Don Callis Family accepted a men's Blood and Guts match for November 4.
